payload.text: Miles's bio mentions the view from his apartment — 'morning light over the canal, looks like it was filtered'.
Recent Instagram post — a coffee cup on a windowsill. The reflection in the glass shows a familiar bridge.
Bio: 'Backend engineer turned hobbyist photographer. Shoots Portra 400.'
His latest profile photo is different — same background, but the smile is gone. He looks like someone caught off guard.
Dev's text from day 4: 'that guy you matched with — Miles? saw him out by the canal warehouse late on Tuesday. that's the one the news mentioned, right?'
Jules's bio: 'I close most weeknights. it's mine after eleven.'
Recent Jules IG story: a quiet street at 2am, captioned 'just walked it off'.
Jules updated his profile pic. Same low light. Different smile — the kind that doesn't reach his eyes.
Dev's text from day 4: 'so that bartender Jules — Sasha says he 'closed alone' tuesday but the bar was dark by ten. weird.'
Tessa's bio: 'midnight to four most weeknights — i'm the voice nobody asked for.'
Recent Tessa IG — a keychain dropped on a studio console. Caption: 'mood after another long one.'
Dev's text: 'Tessa wasn't on air Tuesday — station ran a rerun. she told me she was working.'
Tessa's profile pic flipped overnight — same booth, same headphones. The smile is gone and she's looking just past the camera.
Ren's bio: 'on the water before sunrise. four-thirty most mornings.'
Recent Ren IG — a marina under floodlights. Caption: 'first one in.'
Dev's text: 'marina logs say Ren signed out at 2am, not 4:30 like he claimed.'
Ren swapped his profile shot. Same dock, same hat — the smile is set differently now, like he's measuring the distance to the camera.
Kai's bio: 'finishing a piece down by the old transit lot. swing by — afternoon light's good.'
Recent Kai IG — a half-finished mural shot from the scissor lift. Caption: 'long week. worth it.'
Dev's text: 'Kai said he was painting late by the transit lot — but the lot's been fenced off all month.'
Kai's new profile pic — same paint-splattered denim, but the easy grin has settled into something he's holding very still.
Delphine's bio: 'quiet nights at the shop. perfume's better when the city's asleep.'
Recent Delphine IG — a workbench of bottles and a half-burnt candle. Caption: 'tonight's batch.'
Dev's text: 'Delphine's shop receipts have her opening at 7am the morning after — but she told you she was 'home all night'.'
Delphine's profile pic changed. Same shop counter behind her — the easy smile is now a thinner line, and she's not quite looking at the lens.
River's bio: 'sundays alone on rock that scares my clients. cell signal optional.'
Recent River IG — a trailhead at first light. Caption: 'just me and the rock.'
Dev's text: 'a hiker placed River at the gorge trailhead with someone else last sunday — not solo like he said.'
River's profile pic shifted — same sun-bleached crag in the background, but the loose grin has gone careful, like he's done the math on what you've seen.
Sam's bio: 'overnights on the unit. coffee with too much sugar. don't @ me.'
Recent Sam IG — a breakroom shelf of paperback mysteries. Caption: 'finished another one tonight.'
Dev's text: 'badge swipes show Sam was offsite for two hours during her supposed double shift.'
Sam's profile pic updated — same cardigan, same kind face. The eyes are doing something the smile isn't.
